_note: Slide 21. Runs verbatim against the Transform target index because the transform names its output fields to match. category_field gives one RCF model per agent (~1 MB each; 212 fits in a coordinator's heap, 20,000 is a cardinality budget you pay for in plugins.anomaly_detection.model_max_size_percent). shingle_size 8 x 10 minutes means the model sees an 80-minute shape, so a metronome is anomalous even when its volume is not. Reading the 1-minute rollup rather than raw spans is the same detection at a sixtieth of the I/O.
